decks.name: LeetCode #212 - Word Search II
decks.description: Find all words from a given list that can be formed by sequentially adjacent cells in a 2D board

cards.question: Word Search II: Given an m x n board of characters and a list of strings words, return all words on the board. Each word must be constructed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells, where adjacent cells are horizontally or vertically neighboring. The same letter cell may not be used more than once in a word.

solutions.name: Backtracking (Trie)
solutions.explanation: Build a trie from all words with reference counting for optimization. Use DFS backtracking from each cell, following trie paths. When a word is found, mark it to avoid duplicates and prune the trie by decrementing reference counts. This eliminates unnecessary branches during search.

solutions.explanation: Build a trie from all words for efficient prefix matching. Use DFS backtracking from each cell, following only valid trie paths. Use hash set for results to automatically handle duplicates. Track visited cells to prevent reuse within a single word.
